start.text:
You wake up in a dimly lit room. The air is damp and smells of rust. A single flickering bulb hangs from the ceiling, casting uneasy shadows across the concrete walls.

You can hear a faint humming sound coming from behind a heavy metal door to your left. To your right, a narrow corridor stretches into darkness.

search_room.text: You fumble around the room but don't find much of use. The walls are bare and the floor seems solid. Nothing here but dust and shadows.

search_room_thorough.text:
Your sharp senses guide you. You notice a loose floor tile that others might miss. Underneath, you find a flashlight — still working — and a crumpled note.

The note reads: 'If you're reading this, don't trust the blue light. The water is the way out. - M'

You pocket the flashlight and the note.

choices.text: Head into the corridor with your flashlight
